newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Diesel Engine to issue shares, buy stake.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Diesel Engine to issue shares, buy stake.

text.p: Shanghai Diesel Engine plans to issue up to 85 million new B shares and purchase a 51 percent stake in the Yangzhou Xinxing Power Co, a company statement said on Saturday.
But it said the company had yet to obtain final approval from the securities authorities for either the new issue or the purchase.
The statement said the moves were approved at a shareholders' meeting which ending on Sept 10. It gav eno other details.
Shanghai Diesel Engine currently has a total of 395.3 million outstanding shares including 132 million foreign currency B shares and 21.6 million A shares listed in Shanghai.
